title: Noise-Driven Free Boundaries In The Compressible Navier-Stokes Equations
summary: A stochastic free-boundary problem for the three-dimensional barotropic compressible Navier--Stokes equations is studied. The main feature of the model is that the free boundary is transported by a Stratonovich stochastic flow, so that the noise enters the kinematic boundary condition and hence the evolution of the moving domain. An additional Itô forcing in the momentum equation is also allowed. The problem is transformed by a stochastic Lagrangian map generated by the velocity and the transport vector fields.
